annotations.title: Curator flows: net flows, won and lost

description: Curator overview from on-chain flows: without curator, the league of curators (Steakhouse, Gauntlet, Sentora …) by net flow into their vaults over 7, 30 or 90 days, with migration capital won and lost, main migration counterpart, migration-linked share of deposits, depositor trend and the from→to matrix. With curator (a key or operator slug): its win/loss table against every competitor and its large moves with what coincided with each (advertised-APY gap, risk and control steps, loss events), said as coincidence, never cause. An address is not an owner. FREE for the league; per-move detail is paid.

curator.description: A curator key or operator slug (from curators in the league, or operator_check). Omit for the league.

window.description: The period: week, month (default) or quarter.
